messages:
jen: FYI support escalated a customer (cust-8421) seeing widespread 503/504s and p95 timeouts hitting hosted inference eu-west since ~09:12 UTC. They sent a short repro + traces. request ids: rq_834, rq_847, rq_851.

support-bot: Customer report: high failure rate (~18% 5xx) on generate endpoint, spikes correlate with large-batch concurrent calls (batch_size ~64, seq_len ~1024). They provided curl snippet and a short recording.

sam: Can you paste the curl and an example payload? I want to repro locally against staging.

support-bot: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"model":"rwd-open-1","inputs":"...","max_tokens":1024,"batch_size":64}'

mike: Quick checks: kvcache miss rate on eu-west jumped at 09:12 -> 09:18, queue length on runtime-batcher spiked to >120, autoscaler didn't add nodes fast enough. Logs show repeated `grpc: the client connection is closing` from proxy during spikes.

tara: Adding logs snippet:
```
[09:13:02] batcher.queue.length=127
[09:13:04] kvcache.miss=0.72
[09:13:05] runtime.alloc.failed: conn_pool_exhausted
[09:13:06] upstream: 503 Service Unavailable
```

sam: Interesting — this smells like two interacting issues: (1) sudden large concurrent batch volume exhausting conn pools + runtime capacity, (2) kvcache cold-start causing longer runtimes which amplifies queueing. Both cause the gateway to return 503s when backend times out.

jen: Customer says their traffic pattern changed after a deploy in their app at 09:10 where they started multi-threaded batching. They can throttle if we provide a quick mitigation. Need suggested immediate mitigations.

mike: Mitigations we can do now (quick):
- temporarily cap per-API-key concurrent batches to 8 (rate limit)
- enable fallback to smaller model-variant (rwd-open-1-small) for this key
- scale up eu-west runtime pool by +20% manually
- bump conn_pool size in proxy for eu-west

tara: I'll run the scale up and enable fallback. @ops-bot can you patch gateway rate limit for key cust-8421 to concurrent_batches=8?

ops-bot: Acknowledged. Applying temp rate limit to cust-8421 now. Patching proxy conn_pool requires a rolling restart; scheduling to start in 2m with drain.

support-bot: Customer applied app-side throttle and confirmed reduced request rate. Early signals: 5xx rate dropping to ~4% within 4 minutes.

jen: Good. Keep the manual scale until autoscaler changes are in place. We need a short RCA and action items for follow-up and a postmortem recap for the customer.

sam: Root cause summary draft:
- Primary: customer sudden multi-threaded large-batch workload caused sustained queueing on runtime batcher and conn pool exhaustion at proxy, leading to upstream timeouts and 503s.
- Contributing: kvcache cold-starts increased per-request CPU and latency, lengthening batch windows.
- Secondary: autoscaler thresholds too conservative for sudden fanout workload; per-key concurrency limits not blocking this pattern.

mike: Action items (owners + ETA):
- Increase default conn_pool for eu-west and add adaptive conn_pool (mike) — ETA 3d
- Add per-key concurrent_batch cap in product (jen + infra) — ETA 2d rollout
- Autoscaler: add fast-path scale when queue_length > 50 for >30s (sam) — ETA 1w
- KVCaching: prewarm strategy for large-batch patterns + instrument kvcache miss alerts (tara) — ETA 1w
- Docs: update onboarding note for batch_size recommendations and guide for customers (eng-docs) — ETA 4d

tara: I'll own the postmortem writeup skeleton and customer communication draft. Will include timeline and mitigations applied.

jen: For the customer comms include: what happened, steps we took (rate limit, fallback, scale), short-term remediation (we kept scale + will add per-key cap), and expected follow-ups/ETA. Keep it concise.

support-bot: Customer updated: "initial throttling helped, system stable now, appreciate the quick patch" :thumbsup:

sam: We should add an automated alert: if single API key causes batcher.queue.length > 80 for >2min, page oncall. Filing ticket.

mike: Recording action: create ticket INF-7342 for conn_pool adaptive, INF-7343 for per-key cap, INF-7344 for autoscaler fast-path, INF-7345 for kvcache prewarm. Assigning provisional owners as above.

jen: Thanks team. Tara, once you have the postmortem, drop link here and I'll review before sending to customer. Closing this thread when the follow-up tickets exist and owner assignments are confirmed.

ops-bot: Reminder: I will keep the temporary rate limit and fallback for 48h unless change requested. I'll add a scheduled reminder 2023-04-02T09:12:00Z to review.

tara: Postmortem draft link: (internal) /docs/postmortems/INF-8421-batch-spike-draft — will post final by EOD tomorrow.
